author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000287347
* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
pr (P48611, Drosophila)
PTS orthologs
* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source/propagation
The experimental mitochondrion annotation for human PTS (Q03393) comes from a screen deposited in a database LIFEdb (I couldn’t find it: [ref)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC314201/)
I think the IDA should have been an HDA. I made a separate ticket for it.

PTS catalyses the 2nd step in BH4 synthesis that occurs in the cytosol. I don’t think that mitochondria is going to be its main location. There is an [old paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0006291X9291804Y?fr=RR-2&ref=pdf_download&rr=a439d2aabfe4d77e) that “show” a cytoplasmic location (although the figures are black).
title: PAINT issue:PTN000287347 and PTS orthologs
